HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

   C. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   C. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Nationalism in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and conflict transformations in Kenya 4.2 Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
